creator_info: Ian Hafiz, BUT Informatique student in Toulouse
app_type: Hybrid Fullstack Community Platform & Information Utility
design_archetype: Swiss & Modern Utility (Clean, Structured, Warm High-Contrast)

theme_strategy.philosophy: Information-first utility platform prioritizing legibility, intuitive discovery, and emotional warmth for Malaysian students navigating French student life.

color_palette.usage_rules: Malaysian flag colors (Red #CC0001, Blue #010066, Yellow #FFD100) are reserved for key CTAs, active indicators, badges, and the subtle hero animated background shift. Never overpower main content areas with harsh red or yellow blocks.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#2C3E50]
hierarchy.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg text-[#7F8C8D] font-normal leading-relaxed

layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#E0E0E0] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 p-6

rules.page_transition: Initial { opacity: 0, y: 12 }, animate { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, duration 0.2s easeOut
rules.stagger_list: Stagger children by 0.04s for list entrance
rules.rsvp_morph: Smooth icon transform from Plus to Checkmark green badge
rules.hero_gradient_bg: CSS keyframe background-position shift animation (15s infinite ease-in-out) blending subtle tint of primary blue and accent red/yellow ambient glows

visual_enhancers.sticky_header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-white/85 dark:bg-[#0A0A0C]/85 border-b border-[#E0E0E0] shadow-xs
visual_enhancers.sliding_nav_indicator: framer-motion layoutId='activeNav' pill background behind active menu item
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Minimal SVG icon illustration + friendly empathetic microcopy with clear action button
visual_enhancers.skeleton_loaders: Shimmer keyframe loading blocks matching exact card geometries
visual_enhancers.toasts: Sonner top-right toast notifications for RSVP, upvote, post creation, and bookmarking

component_guidelines.header: Sticky nav with Rantau logo + flag badge, links to Events, Resources, Community, Cities, and Profile/Login buttons, with sliding indicator.
component_guidelines.homepage: Hero banner with animated gradient and search bar, upcoming events widget, popular administrative guides (CAF, Ameli, Visa renewal), community discussion feed, city selector pills.
component_guidelines.events: Search/Filter bar, category tags (Cultural, Academic, Social, Sports), Event Card with date badge, location, attendee avatars, RSVP toggle button, Event Detail page with interactive comments & RSVP state.
component_guidelines.resources: Tabbed categories (Administrative, Academic, Living, Community), search with upvote/downvote counters, file download counter, direct link to official portals (CAF, Ameli, Campus France).
component_guidelines.community: Post creation modal/drawer, category/city tags, upvote mechanism, threaded comments, filter by city (Paris, Toulouse, Lyon, All).
component_guidelines.cities: Grid of French student cities with local student counts, weather/tips preview, dedicated City Hub page featuring local events, recommended student spots, and housing tips.
component_guidelines.profile: User information, bookmarked resources, created posts, RSVP'd events list, badge status.

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, vote buttons, and key cards MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='rsvp-button', data-testid='resource-search-input', data-testid='nav-link-events').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default components.
Always set explicit hover and focus contrast states on buttons and inputs.
Include data-testid on all key interactive elements.
Avoid 3D models or particle canvas in this utility app context.
